intents.answer: Thai nationals do not need to complete this TM30 Immigration accommodation registration. After verifying the stay on the permanent Room page, select ‘All overnight guests are Thai nationals’ only if the exemption applies to everyone staying overnight on that reservation. If any non-Thai guest is staying overnight, provide the passport for each one through the secure upload option or present all required passports to The House in person.

triggers: where can i store my luggage
intents.answer: Our office working hours are 10:30 AM–7:30 PM Bangkok time. Luggage storage is available Tuesday–Sunday during those hours. If the office is unavailable, luggage can be stored at Bamboo Beach Bar from 11:00 AM when applicable. We do not currently have luggage storage for early-morning arrivals before 11:00 AM. If you want us to arrange storage, please tell me whether this is for arrival or departure, your requested time, number of bags and any useful notes.

triggers: why should i save water and electricity
where does koh tao electricity come from
intents.answer: Fresh water is limited on Koh Tao. Electricity reaches the island through an undersea grid connection developed to reduce reliance on local diesel generators. Please use water and power thoughtfully, and switch off the air conditioning and lights whenever you leave the room.
Please do not flush toilet paper, wipes or anything else. Use the bin provided. If the toilet is blocked or not working, contact us for help.

intents.answer: Tap water is not suitable for drinking. Bottled water is available nearby. Fresh water is limited on Koh Tao, so please use it responsibly.

where do i upload my passport
i do not want to upload my passport
can i give you my passport in person
intents.answer: This TM30 Immigration accommodation registration applies only to non-Thai guests. Thai nationals do not need to complete it. Open your permanent Room welcome page and verify the Airbnb confirmation code shown in your trip details or the private House stay code provided for a direct booking. Passport information is required for every non-Thai person staying overnight—not only the person who made the booking. You may either use one secure upload form per passport, or choose to present the original passports of every non-Thai overnight adult and child to The House in person. Do not send passport information through this chat or WhatsApp. Securely uploaded passport images are automatically deleted 14 days after upload, or sooner after processing. The private room guide opens after all uploads are received, or after the team confirms the in-person passport check and registration are complete.

The House needs passport information for every non-Thai overnight visitor so we can complete the required TM30 Immigration accommodation registration. Thai nationals do not need to complete this registration. After verifying the Airbnb confirmation code or private House stay code on the permanent Room page, either use the secure upload option once for each non-Thai overnight guest, or choose to present the original passports of every non-Thai overnight adult and child to The House in person. Do not put passport information in this chat or send it through WhatsApp.

intents.answer: The House is in Mae Haad, close to the ferry pier. Open the map below for the exact location. When you arrive, enter beside Bar Thai Food and follow the access route to The House.

intents.answer: Sairee Beach is roughly a 20-minute walk from The House, depending on your pace and the exact part of Sairee you are going to. A scooter or taxi is faster.

intents.answer: This sounds like an urgent property problem. Move away from wet electrical equipment or any immediate danger and call emergency property support now. The concierge has included your room in the support message. If anyone is injured or in immediate medical danger, call Koh Tao Rescue first because they know the island and local access points; you can also call 1669.

intents.answer: For an accident or serious medical emergency, call Koh Tao Rescue first because they know the island and local access points. You can also call Thailand's national medical emergency number 1669. Say that you are on Koh Tao, Surat Thani, explain your exact location and keep your phone nearby.

Koh Tao Hospital provides medical treatment on the island. For a serious or life-threatening emergency, call Koh Tao Rescue first because they know the island and local access points; you can also call 1669.
